nodes.name: rolls_parameters.py
nodes.summary: Abstract base class defining the roll parameters data interface, with a rollParametersMissing exception for absent instruments.

nodes.name: parquet_multiple_prices.py
nodes.summary: Parquet-file-backed storage implementation of the futures multiple prices data interface.

nodes.name: csv_futures_sim_test_data.py
nodes.summary: Lightweight CSV-backed simulation data object bundling adjusted/multiple/fx/roll test fixtures for backtest unit tests.

nodes.name: futures_sim_data.py
nodes.summary: Abstract simulation data interface exposing the price, carry, cost, FX and instrument metadata accessors consumed by the backtesting System.

nodes.name: futures_sim_data_with_data_blob.py
nodes.summary: Concrete futuresSimData implementation backed by a dataBlob, wiring production DB data sources into the simulation data interface.

nodes.name: update_provided_multiple_prices.py
nodes.summary: Ad-hoc interactive init script that rebuilds and splices multiple prices for a user-chosen instrument from DB prices and CSV roll calendars.

nodes.name: adjustedprices_from_db_multiple_to_db.py
nodes.summary: Init pipeline that computes back-adjusted prices from DB multiple prices and writes them back to the DB and/or CSV for all or single instruments.

nodes.name: build_multiple_prices_from_raw_data.py
nodes.summary: Core init algorithm that stitches per-contract closing prices into a continuous multiple-price stack (price/forward/carry columns) using a roll calendar.

nodes.name: build_roll_calendars.py
nodes.summary: Largest init module: generates approximate roll calendars from roll parameters, then adjusts each roll date to the nearest valid date with matching current/next prices, and can back out calendars from existing multiple prices.

nodes.name: clone_data_for_instrument.py
nodes.summary: Init utility that clones per-contract, multiple, adjusted price and roll-calendar data from one instrument to another, with optional inversion/scaling/offset.

nodes.name: clone_large_to_small_contracts.py
nodes.summary: Thin runner mapping full-size instruments to their mini/micro equivalents and invoking clone_data_for_instrument for each pair.

nodes.name: rollParametersData
nodes.summary: Abstract base defining the roll parameters interface with keyed get/add/delete by instrument.

nodes.name: parquetFuturesMultiplePricesData
nodes.summary: Parquet-backed multiple prices store implementing the get/add/delete primitives via a parquet access layer.

nodes.name: _change_contracts_to_str
nodes.summary: Converts the per-contract identifier columns of a multiple-prices DataFrame to strings for parquet storage.

nodes.name: CsvFuturesSimTestData
nodes.summary: CSV-backed simulation data fixture exposing adjusted/multiple/carry/fx accessors for backtest tests.

nodes.name: futuresSimData
nodes.summary: Abstract simulation data interface providing price, carry, cost, FX, roll and instrument-metadata accessors for the backtesting engine.

nodes.name: genericBlobUsingFuturesSimData
nodes.summary: Concrete simulation data object that resolves price/fx/instrument/roll data via a production dataBlob.

nodes.name: process_adjusted_prices_all_instruments
nodes.summary: Iterates all instruments computing and storing adjusted prices from DB multiple prices.

nodes.name: process_adjusted_prices_single_instrument
nodes.summary: Computes back-adjusted prices for one instrument from its multiple prices and writes to DB and/or CSV.

nodes.name: rollCalendarWithRollIndex
nodes.summary: Iterator wrapper over a roll calendar tracking the current roll row while building a price stack.

nodes.name: create_multiple_price_stack_from_raw_data
nodes.summary: Builds a continuous multiple-price stack from per-contract closing prices by walking the roll calendar.

nodes.name: _get_price_data_between_rolls
nodes.summary: Extracts the slice of contract price data covering the period between two consecutive rolls.

nodes.name: _calc_roll_date_info
nodes.summary: Derives roll-date boundary information for the current roll-calendar row.

nodes.name: _calc_contract_date_info
nodes.summary: Resolves current/next/carry contract dates and validates them against available price data.

nodes.name: _get_current_next_carry_data
nodes.summary: Assembles current, next and carry price series for the current roll window.

nodes.name: _get_next_price_data
nodes.summary: Builds the next-contract price column for the roll window.

nodes.name: _get_carry_price_data
nodes.summary: Builds the carry-contract price column for the roll window.

nodes.name: _build_all_price_data
nodes.summary: Concatenates the per-window price/forward/carry frames into the full multiple-price stack.

nodes.name: generate_approximate_calendar
nodes.summary: Generates an approximate roll calendar from roll parameters and the set of available contract prices.

nodes.name: _create_approx_calendar_from_earliest_contract
nodes.summary: Walks forward from the earliest contract creating an approximate roll-calendar row per contract.

nodes.name: _get_new_row_of_roll_calendar
nodes.summary: Builds a single approximate roll-calendar row (current/next/carry contracts and roll date) from the current contract.

nodes.name: adjust_to_price_series
nodes.summary: Adjusts every approximate roll date to the nearest valid date where current and next contracts both have prices.

nodes.name: _get_local_data_for_row_number
nodes.summary: Gathers the local prior/current/next row context needed to adjust a single roll date.

nodes.name: _adjust_row_of_approx_roll_calendar
nodes.summary: Adjusts one roll-calendar rows roll date using matching price data, optionally ignoring carry.

nodes.name: _get_set_of_prices
nodes.summary: Collects the current/next/carry price series required to validate a candidate roll date.

nodes.name: _get_carry_contract_and_prices
nodes.summary: Resolves the carry contract and its price series for the row being adjusted.

nodes.name: _find_best_matching_roll_date
nodes.summary: Finds the closest valid roll date to the approximate date where paired prices exist, avoiding a blocked date.

nodes.name: _add_carry_calendar
nodes.summary: Appends carry-contract information to a completed roll calendar.

nodes.name: back_out_roll_calendar_from_multiple_prices
nodes.summary: Reconstructs a roll calendar by inferring roll dates from an existing multiple-prices series.

nodes.name: _get_roll_calendar_from_roll_dates_and_unique_prices
nodes.summary: Builds roll-calendar rows from inferred roll dates and the de-duplicated multiple-prices series.

nodes.name: _add_extra_row_to_implied_roll_calendar
nodes.summary: Appends a final synthetic row to an implied roll calendar so the last contract is covered.

nodes.name: _listOfRollCalendarRows
nodes.summary: List subclass of roll-calendar rows with helpers to convert to a DataFrame and read the last roll date.

nodes.name: clone_data_for_instrument
nodes.summary: Top-level cloning routine copying per-contract, multiple, adjusted and roll-calendar data from one instrument to another.

nodes.name: clone_prices_per_contract
nodes.summary: Clones per-contract price data for a list of contract dates, applying inversion/scaling/offset.

nodes.name: clone_single_contract
nodes.summary: Clones the price series of a single contract, optionally inverting, scaling and offsetting prices before writing.

nodes.name: clone_multiple_prices
nodes.summary: Clones the multiple-prices series from one instrument to another with optional transforms.

nodes.name: clone_adjusted_prices
nodes.summary: Clones the adjusted-prices series from one instrument to another with optional transforms.
